run_xds_tests: run xDS integration tests on GCP Traffic Director with ping_pong or round_robin test cases
create_gcp_resources: create GCP health checks, backend services, instance groups, URL maps, and forwarding rules for xDS testing
verify_backend_rpcs: verify that all RPCs go to given backends using wait_until_all_rpcs_go_to_given_backends
get_client_stats: get load balancer client stats via gRPC GetClientStats RPC to check RPC distribution by peer
resize_instance_group: resize a GCP instance group to a new size and wait for the operation to complete
